title: Accenture Technology Vision 2011: The technology waves that are reshaping the business landscape
notes: Eight trends, each a chapter. Published date from PDF creation date (2011-01-19). Methodology: Accenture Technology Labs developed hypotheses in late 2010 about developments with significant impact on clients in the next five years. Earliest publicly readable edition.

entries.label: Data Takes its Rightful Place as a Platform
entries.quote: The age of viewing everything through an application lens is coming to an end.
entries.subject: Data platforms
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: Analytics Is Driving a Discontinuous Evolution from BI
entries.quote: Analytics is emerging as a major differentiator and value creator for businesses.
entries.subject: Business analytics
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: Cloud Computing Will Create More Value Higher up the Stack
entries.quote: Together, SaaS and PaaS rather than IaaS will enable IT to create value through a combination of cost reduction, speed to market, agility, and the ability to gracefully integrate business processes with partners and suppliers.
entries.subject: Cloud computing (SaaS, PaaS)
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: Architecture Will Shift from Server-centric to Service-centric
entries.quote: More mature tools, frameworks, and methodologies will pave the way toward process-centric IT.
entries.subject: Service-oriented architecture
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: IT Security Will Respond Rapidly, Progressively—and in Proportion
entries.quote: What’s needed now is a cascaded, reflex-like security architecture that responds proportionately to threats when and where they happen.
entries.subject: IT security
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: Data Privacy Will Adopt a Risk-based Approach
entries.quote: Leading organizations already know that. They will be attuned to regulations governing privacy and will develop a risk-based approach to data privacy.
entries.subject: Data privacy
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: Social Platforms Will Emerge as a New Source of Business Intelligence
entries.quote: Social networks will evolve into “platforms” for reaching customers, tapping into their social identity, and gaining information about them, and about competitors and the market as a whole.
entries.subject: Social media platforms
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.

entries.label: User Experience is What Matters
entries.quote: The ability to create experiences by deeply engaging the user, using natural interfaces and integrating processes and devices, will be what differentiates leading companies and systems from the rest.
entries.subject: User experience and natural interfaces
entries.note: Horizon is edition-level: the Research Methodology says the hypotheses concern developments with significant impact 'in the next five years'.
